prompt: Which Pope served the longest between the Battle of the Milvian Bridge and the end of the Civil Wars of the Tetrarchy?
answer: **Pope Sylvester I** served the longest. He was pope from **31 January 314 to 31 December 335**, covering roughly the final decade of the Civil Wars of the Tetrarchy through their end in **324**. Miltiades was pope during the Battle of the Milvian Bridge in 312 but died in January 314.
